read_only_audit.method: Read-only CPU reconciliation of strict source formulas, sealed JSON/CSV/histograms and pinned M328 rows. The raw 1.01376-billion task producer was not rerun; M341 already has an exact-SHA replay receipt, and M333 independently reconstructed the M328 source populations and B0.

population_and_b0_recompute.finding: B0 exact reproduction is sound. The strict direct K8 bypass has identical M328 work and cycles at every module and combined scope.

budget_work_conservation.finding: No source work is lost or duplicated in the retained aggregate ledger. The 4-bit upper bound is conservative in source code and all frozen output rows report zero bound and capacity violations. Nonzero-budget accuracy remains intentionally unadmitted.

capture.assumption: Eight ascending active IDs, eight arbitrary code lookups and stable per-code compaction complete every capture cycle; no additional context-publication or final partial-word flush cycle is charged.

stable_bucket_packing.formula: R = sum over nonempty codes c of ceil(n_c/8)

registered_reservoir.per_word_formula: For kept suffix k_w and bank occupancies r_b, choose the smallest d_w>=1 such that sum_b max(r_b-d_w,0)+k_w<=16; then r_b=max(r_b-d_w,0)+a_wb.

drain_only.source_behavior: When a packed word lies fully before the cutoff, word_kept=0. The minimum delay remains one, so the word contributes exactly one stage2 cycle before any tail effect.
drain_only.consequence: R is budget-independent in M341 even though the kept suffix shrinks. This is correct for the frozen all-word-drain machine, but prevents post-hoc evaluation of pointer-skip or cross-code repacking.

stream_order.formula: per task penalty = E - max(R,Q), where Q is the maximum kept population over the eight modulo banks
stream_order.finding: The penalty is a diagnostic above two simultaneous lower bounds, not an additional term to add on top of E.

two_context_flow_shop.capture_start: max(previous capture_end, stage2_end two tasks earlier)
two_context_flow_shop.finding: The recurrence implements a legal blocking two-context group-major flow shop. Capture-context wait, startup and final-drain fields are overlapping diagnostics already represented in the timeline; they are not additional total-cycle terms.

metric_namespace_and_amdahl_audit.m341_total_speedup_namespace: combined ten FC1 modules plus one selected patch Conv schedule speedup versus the same M328 group4 K8 issue-cycle baseline
metric_namespace_and_amdahl_audit.finding: Because every evaluated module schedule is slower than its K8 baseline, Amdahl dilution cannot turn the frozen route into a system acceleration for any positive affected fraction. M341 correctly leaves system_speedup and headline false, but the generic field name total_speedup should remain qualified as selected-scope schedule speedup.

no_go_sufficiency.proof_1: Every nonzero combined point is below 1.0 and below the 1.15 promotion gate; the best is B1024 at 0.625315x.
no_go_sufficiency.proof_2: Mandatory bucket-word drain alone is 9,763,838,328 cycles, already greater than the 6,681,676,272-cycle baseline. Even if reservoir stalls, tail, capture bubbles and metadata were free, frozen-route speedup is at most 0.6843288517835032x.
no_go_sufficiency.proof_3: All eleven modules are slower, so selective enablement among the evaluated module implementations does not produce a positive-speedup candidate.
no_go_sufficiency.gpu_gate: NO_GO is sufficient without accuracy testing because the hardware schedule already fails performance.
unproven_alternatives: skip fully dropped prefix words by bucket pointer arithmetic
pack kept suffixes across code boundaries after the cutoff
emit a cutoff plus bank queues without draining discarded words through stage2
a different selector/issue overlap or storage organization
no_go_sufficiency.required_scope: The current decision must be read as a kill of M341's frozen stable-16-bucket all-word-drain architecture, not of the cumulative-budget idea family.

p1.title: The decision label is broader than the architecture that was killed
p1.evidence: M341 mandates one cycle for every packed word, including fully dropped prefix words, and does not retain a drain-only count. The resulting constant 9.7638B drain is decisive for that machine but does not evaluate pointer-skip or post-cutoff cross-code packing.
p1.impact: NO_GO_CONSERVATIVE_CODE_AFTER_CPU_TASK_SCHEDULE can be misread as a universal mechanism kill.
p1.required_fix: Rename the decision to NO_GO_M341_FROZEN_STABLE16_BUCKET_ALL_WORD_DRAIN_ROUTE_B. Any alternative must be a new contract and must not inherit M341 performance numbers.

p2.title: B0 selector-cycle fields contain legacy K8 issue cycles
p2.evidence: At B0, registered_reservoir_stage2_cycles and two_context_pipeline_cycles are both 6,681,676,272 and lane_idle_slots is 18,346,552,992 despite the strict selector bypass.
p2.impact: The total is correct, but these fields cannot be interpreted as B0 selector overhead.
p2.required_fix: Add legacy_k8_issue_cycles and set selector/reservoir/two-context counters to zero at B0, or rename them as effective service fields.

p2.title: b0_exact is true on every nonzero-budget row
p2.evidence: policy_row defines b0_exact as budget_index!=0 OR the actual B0 checks.
p2.impact: The value is harmless to the current top-level check but semantically meaningless on B16..B1024 rows.
p2.required_fix: Keep B0 reproduction as one top-level/module identity and omit or null the field on nonzero policies.

p2.title: Cycle diagnostics are not explicitly classified as additive or overlapping
p2.evidence: capture_context_wait, startup, final drain, overlap-floor excess, stage2 wait and stream-order penalty describe overlapping aspects of the same flow-shop timeline.
p2.impact: Summing the visible counters would double count cycles.
p2.required_fix: Publish one additive ledger: bucket words + reservoir stalls + tail + stage2-wait + metadata; label all other counters diagnostic_nonadditive.

p2.title: Drain-only words are enforced but not counted separately
p2.evidence: Source inspection proves a fully dropped word consumes one cycle, but JSON/CSV/histograms do not retain the number of such words or their cycles.
p2.impact: The dominant NO-GO cause cannot be partitioned into kept-word fragmentation versus discarded-prefix drain from the sealed artifact.
p2.required_fix: Add full_drop_words, partial_cutoff_words, kept_words and their stage2 cycles per budget.

p2.title: Packing finalization and storage footprint remain analytical
p2.evidence: C=ceil(A/8) assumes zero extra partial-word publication/flush cycles and an II1 eight-lookup stable compactor. The reported 4.0x ratio covers only 498,816 persistent bytes; M341-declared scratchpad, ping-pong and reservoir logical storage raises persistent-plus-runtime bytes to 518,512, or 4.157942x of the one-bit reference.
p2.impact: This reinforces NO-GO but prevents using M341 for implementation or area claims.
p2.required_fix: Keep the current CPU-only boundary; if the architecture is revived, price context publication, compactor timing and all runtime SRAM/register state separately from persistent metadata.
